newsitem.title: MEXICO: SOCCER-SANCHEZ JOINING EX-REAL TEAM MATES IN MEXICO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SANCHEZ JOINING EX-REAL TEAM MATES IN MEXICO.

text.p: Veteran striker Hugo Sanchez is poised to sign for Mexico's Atletico Celaya, joining two former team mates from his days at Real Madrid.
Sanchez, 38, arrived late on Friday from Spain and travelled immediately to the central industrial city to join the increasingly fashionable club known as "The Bulls".
"We have agreed on the time and money questions (of my contract) and there are only a few minute details to tie up before I sign," Sanchez told reporters.
Sanchez said it would be his last season and he was relishing the opportunity to line up with former team mates Emilio "Buitre" Butragueno and Miguel Gonzalez "Michel".

"I started my football career in Mexico and I want to end and die playing the sport in Mexico," Sanchez said."I did it not only for sentimental reasons but also because Michel and Butragueno are here."

After retiring, Sanchez plans to turn to management. "I have received proposals to manage clubs in the United States, Austria, Spain and Mexico and next season I will move into a managing role," he said.
